messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning a serial apply tonight for release/2026.03.21. Changes: add cross-account IAM role for metrics ingestion, attach KMS access, bump provider to hashicorp/aws v4.50. Change window 23:00-00:30 UTC. I'm going to pin provider in the PR. Need rollback ladder + confirmations before merge. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/4188

dan: ack. can you paste a short plan summary? any VPC/network changes?

alex: plan snippet: + aws_iam_role.metrics_ingest, + aws_iam_policy_attachment.metrics_attach, + aws_kms_key.metrics_key. No subnets/route tables touched. terraform plan: 5 to add, 0 change, 0 destroy. provider bump noted — might change LB behaviour but we didn't touch LBs.

priya: prefer adding the provider pin at the repo root (not only module). also need a KMS key policy review from security (cc @marta).

marta: security: reviewed KMS policy — ok with conditional cross-account principal, leaving signed-off comment on the PR.

ops-bot: Deploybot preflight: queue position 4. Estimated runtime 25–35m. serial apply flag set. Canary disabled for serial apply.

sam: who will be oncall for rollback tonight? I can standby 23:00–00:30 UTC if needed.

leah: FYI deploybot defaults to a 20m resource creation timeout. if the IAM role creation takes >20m it can time out; suggest setting `--max-wait=40m` for this run. also add a quick smoke check step after apply.

alex: will set `--max-wait=40m` and pin provider in the PR. suggested rollback ladder: 1) cancel apply, 2) revert infra commit (create rollback PR), 3) apply revert (serial), 4) manual cleanup for any partial resources. Documented in PR notes. Thoughts?

dan: +1. please prepare the revert PR ahead of time so we can hit merge quicker if needed. I'll draft the revert and link it in the release notes.

priya: add a customer-facing risk line to release notes: "no app downtime expected; possible delay in metrics ingestion during rollback" — put it under "risk & rollback".

marta: security confirms cross-account access with conditions is acceptable. posted the signed comment in PR.

deploybot: preflight check: state lock OK, no drift detected. Warning: workspace provider currently v4.49; deploybot will honor repo pin if present. If not pinned, provider override will be applied at runtime.

alex: merging PR to allow staging verification at ~22:10 UTC. release note tag: "release/2026.03.21 infra: iam metrics role".

ops-bot: reminder: if rollback escalates, open incident in #incidents and escalate to @marta (security) + @oncall-eng. I'll auto-create an ephemeral incident if `rollback=true` is triggered.

sam: I'll run the prod apply: `deploybot apply --workspace=prod --max-wait=40m --serial` from `infra/terraform/prod`. I'll monitor logs and be ready to revert.

leah: add post-apply smoke: `./scripts/smoke_metrics_ingest.sh` which runs `curl -f https://metrics.ingest/health` and validates sample event ingestion in Datadog (dash: infra.metrics.ingest.latency).

alex: added smoke script and rollback steps to PR. staging pass required before 23:00. pinging this thread once staging is green.

dan: ping when staging passes. :thumbsup:
